centralizer.permutation_convention: permutation[i] sends contact p_i to p_permutation[i]

clause_simplification.positive_row_scaling: F_i lambda(z)=(sum_j F_ij)*(normalized_pair_row_i lambda(z)); row sums are strictly positive
clause_simplification.strict_domain: all off-diagonal F entries >0, pair dominance F_i,sigma(i)>=sum of the other two off-diagonal entries, and D=sum_j c_j>2
clause_simplification.triangle_rule: row atom is possible iff the triangle minimum is negative or both admissible dominance-edge values are zero; maximum <=0 makes the whole clause tautological

lra_implications.antecedent: strict pair domain plus the 40 retained original-box clauses
lra_implications.interpretation: 56 of 68 added non-tautological clauses follow from the original 40; 12 are individually new, and 8 form an irredundant basis once those 12 are jointly available.

scope.closure_use: The 432-point set is an exact finite equivariant enlargement of the [-2,3]^3 screen.
